data.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
data.description: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.
